summary: Recorded an unsettled point in the VerifyLeader account from an attempted end-to-end variant: after the leader is cut from the voters it steps down at its next lease check, and even a forced majority campaign left the partitioned node a Follower by the time the newer value committed, so a positive verification concurrent with already-stale FSM data was not captured. The limitation keeps the two-window alignment question open rather than claiming the stale read end to end.
